name: Parametric Quadtree Traversal
aliases: parametric algorithm for octree traversal (2D variant)
definition: A method for traversing a 2D quadtree (or 3D octree) using parametric ray equations to determine entry and exit points into child nodes, avoiding division by zero and handling arbitrary ray directions via coordinate flipping.
summary: Parametric Quadtree Traversal is a top-down ray-quadtree intersection algorithm that uses parametric coordinates to efficiently traverse 2D spatial hierarchies without branching on ray direction signs.
